title: Slapping the Face of an Old Enemy
next_chapter_hook: The news spread like wildfire across the Four Great Sects—that Chen Ji, the waste everyone had mocked, had actually stomped the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect under his foot. And those secretly watching were far more than just the forces on the surface...

text.content:
In the thunderous roar of the prohibition's collapse, Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes.

The golden light-flowing master-recognizing ceremony had been forcibly interrupted at the last moment—but what did that matter? He had already sensed the extra connection in his body—the remnant soul's acknowledgment of the Ancient Ruins' Master. From this moment on, he was the true master of these ancient ruins.

Looking toward the cave entrance, Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward. That smile was calm to the point of being almost gentle, yet it made Ye Qing, who had just woken up beside him, shiver inexplicably.

"They came rather quickly."

dialogue.content:
"Hahaha! Chen Ji, did you think hiding in a place like this would let you survive?"

The wild laughter shook pebbles loose. Han Lie, clad in dark iron battle armor, strode into the arena, eight Xuanwu elites的气势如虹 behind him, blocking the cave entrance completely. He looked down at this "waste" with only contempt in his eyes.

"Master-recognizing ceremony? That's hilarious. With your pathetic cultivation, how dare you covet ancient fortune?"

Chen Ji didn't answer, just watched him quietly. That gaze was too calm, too calm for Han Lie's comfort—it irritated him inexplicably.

"What's that look for?" Han Lie narrowed his eyes. "The look of a prisoner?"

"Eight breaths." Chen Ji suddenly spoke.

"What?"

"Your remaining lifespan. Eight breaths."

text.content:
The air seemed to freeze for a moment.

Ye Qing stood frozen, not understanding. The eight Xuanwu elites exchanged glances, then burst into laughter—wastes are wastes, babbling nonsense before death.

Only Han Lie's laughter stopped abruptly. He stared fixedly at Chen Ji's placid eyes, and an inexplicable chill rose in his heart.

Impossible. He's just a waste. He's definitely putting on an act.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing finally reacted, her figure flickering to block in front of Chen Ji, demonic path mist quietly gathering in her palm.

"Chen Ji, you've completed the master-recognizing." Her voice was extremely low. "This is your主场, no need for pleasantries with him."

"The Saint Maiden is here too." Han Lie sneered. "Has the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path run out of people, reduced to being a bodyguard for a waste?"

He raised his hand, Xuanwu battle intent erupting violently. "Today, neither of you is leaving alive!"

text.content:
Chen Ji gently patted Ye Qing's shoulder, signaling her to step back.

Then, he took a step forward.

That step seemed casual, but falling in Han Lie's eyes it was like stomping on his heart. His pupils constricted—because the instant Chen Ji raised his foot, the entire ruins trembled!

The ground, walls, dome... countless ancient runes lit up with golden radiance, like a slumbering beast opening its eyes.

"The ruins... moved?!"

dialogue.content:
"I forgot to tell you." Chen Ji's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. "Just before you arrived, I had already become the master of these ruins."

He raised his hand, pointing at the eight Xuanwu elites behind Han Lie, his tone as casual as commenting on the weather.

"Kneel, or die."

The words fell, and the ruins' power crashed down! Eight golden chains materialized from nothing, directly targeting the eight men's throats—this was the authority of the Ruins Master, forcibly suppressing all cultivators below the Nascent Soul realm!

text.content:
Thud! Thud! Thud!

The eight Xuanwu elites had no resistance, their knees crashing heavily into the ground, the sound of shattered bones clearly audible. Their faces pale white, they struggled desperately, yet found even their fingers couldn't move.

"This—this is impossible!" Han Lie's eyes nearly burst from their sockets. "You're cheating! You must be cheating!"

He tried to act, but discovered in horror that his Xuanwu battle intent was being死死 suppressed by a vast and mighty power, his spiritual energy frozen as if sealed in ice.

dialogue.content:
"Cheating?" Chen Ji slowly walked toward Han Lie, each step seeming to crush his dignity.

"Young Master Han, since entering the sect, you've treated me like an ant, trampling me whenever you wished." He stopped before his opponent, looking down. "Did you ever imagine the ant might turn the tables?"

"No! I don't believe it!" Han Lie's eyes were bloodshot. "I'm Xuanwu Sect's number one genius! I'm invincible! You're just a waste—"

Slap!

A slap cut off his words.

text.content:
The crisp sound echoed through the ruins.

Han Lie was slapped飞出去 three zhang away, half his face swelling like a pig's head instantly. He clutched his face, eyes full of disbelief—this waste actually dared to hit him? Publicly hit him?!

Ye Qing watched目瞪口呆 from the side, then her lips twitched slightly.

She suddenly felt that this "Waste Chen" was rather elegant and lethal in his methods of dealing with people.

dialogue.content:
"Three years ago, you humiliated me before the entire sect, saying I wasn't fit to carry your shoes." Chen Ji walked up to Han Lie, crouched down, and pinched his chin, forcing him to meet his gaze.

"Two years ago, you sent people to burn my dwelling, just because you thought I looked at you the wrong way."

"Half a year ago, you publicly stomped on the elixirs I'd saved for three years at the market, simply because I wanted to buy a vein-repairing grass."

He released his hand, patting Han Lie's cheek. "Young Master Han, I've kept a very clear account of these debts."

text.content:
Han Lie trembled all over, whether from rage or fear.

He opened his mouth, wanting to say something fierce, but found his throat blocked by something, unable to utter a single word. Those terrifyingly calm eyes watching him were like looking at a lamb awaiting slaughter.

No, even more pitiful than a lamb.

Because a lamb could at least struggle. But he now didn't even have the qualification to struggle.

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't waste words. He raised his hand, ruins' power condensing into a golden sword, its tip pointing directly at Han Lie's brow center.

"No... don't..." Han Lie finally showed genuine fear, his voice trembling. "Chen Ji, you can't kill me! My father is the Xuanwu Sect Master! If you kill me, the entire Xuanwu Sect won't let you off—"

"Annoying."

Sword light flashed. Blood sprayed. Han Lie's body slowly fell, his eyes filled with disbelief.

text.content:
Chen Ji withdrew his hand, turning to walk to the main seat and sit down.

"Kowtow." He said calmly. "Kowtow one hundred times to these ruins, shout 'Young Master Chen, spare my life' one hundred times, and you and your men can leave alive."

"You dream!" Han Lie howled.

"No matter." Chen Ji snapped his fingers. "The ruins will help you kowtow."

Golden light surged again, Han Lie's body uncontrollably kneeling, his forehead pounding heavily against the ground again and again.

text.content:
Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, his tone calm.

"Get lost."

Han Lie froze, not daring to believe his ears: "You... you're not going to kill me?"

"Kill you, and Xuanwu Sect would come in full force." Chen Ji smiled meaningfully. "I'm not that stupid. Keeping you isn't because I can't kill you, but because you're not worth killing."

He waved his hand, lifting the prohibition, golden light fading. "Remember today's humiliation. Next time you transgress, I'll let you understand what living hell truly means."

No matter what choice Chen Ji made, Han Lie's fate was already sealed—whether death, utter disgrace, or escaping with humiliation, this former Xuanwu genius would become the loudest stepping stone on Chen Ji's path to rise.

Outside the ruins, the scouts secretly observing had already spread this scene to all directions.

The news that Chen Ji master-recognized the Tianji Record Fragment and defeated Han Lie spread with startling speed to various powers.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji." Ye Qing walked to his side, her gaze complicated. "This move of yours has truly set yourself on the fire."

"It doesn't matter." Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, gazing at the horizon beyond the cave entrance. "The fire needs to be hot enough to illuminate what I want them to see."

Ye Qing was stunned, then thoughtful: "You deliberately..."

"What must come will come." Chen Ji smiled faintly. "Compared to passive waiting, I prefer active maneuvering."

text.content:
In the distant horizon, several streaks of light could be vaguely seen rushing toward this direction.

Clearly, various forces had received the news. Some wanted to take advantage of the chaos, some wanted to recruit talent, and others... wanted to eliminate witnesses.

But Chen Ji only watched quietly, that smile at the corner of his mouth growing increasingly profound.

The chess game is set, a move made cannot be taken back.

This round, he would let the entire world know—that Chen Ji, the waste everyone could bully, would from this day forth become an existence they could never ignore.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji!!!!!"

From the distance came Han Lie's frantic roar, his voice full of unwillingness and venom. "Wait for me! I will definitely kill you! Definitely!"

Chen Ji was deaf to it, only gently waving his hand.

The ruins' passage slowly closed, completely isolating that disheveled figure outside.

text.content:
Inside the ruins, peace returned.

Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at the faint golden pattern in his palm—the contract mark between the Ruins Master and himself. With it, he was the absolute sovereign within these ruins.

"Tianji Record..." he silently recited in his heart, feeling the information transmitted from the fragment.

Although interrupted, the master-recognizing was mostly complete. As time passed, more secrets of the ruins would open to him. And what happened today was merely a small experiment.

Ye Qing watched Chen Ji's back, an indescribable feeling welling up in her heart.

This man, with his ordinary appearance, cultivation only at Foundation Building late stage, yet his deep布局 and meticulous planning made even her, the Demonic Path Saint Maiden, feel chills.

"Who exactly are you?" she couldn't help but ask.

Chen Ji turned back, smiling gently: "Just a waste, that's all."

Ye Qing: "..."

She didn't believe his nonsense at all.

Tianqing Sect, Council Hall.

A disciple rushed in, kneeling on one knee: "Reporting to the Sect Master! News from the ruins—Chen Ji succeeded in master-recognition, defeated Han Lie publicly!"

On the main seat, Ling Yuan opened his slightly closed eyes, a trace of indecipherable light flickering in his gaze.

"...Interesting." he murmured, his voice low. "It seems this young man is more extraordinary than I imagined."

His fingers tapped the armrest lightly, as if calculating something.
